metadata.title: Seedance 2.5: Features, Availability, API, Pricing & Examples
metadata.description: Explore ByteDance Seedance 2.5 features, launch status, access surfaces, API direction, pricing questions, and example workflows from the Seed model.

hero.title: Seedance 2.5
hero.description: Seedance 2.5 AI is a next-generation video model for longer storytelling, multimodal references, and precise editing. This site currently keeps its browser generator on Seedance 2.0 while 2.5 access depends on supported providers.
hero.tip: Seedance 2.5 is not connected to this site’s browser generator. Check the official provider for current regions, plans, model IDs, and limits.

introduce.title: What Seedance 2.5 adds
introduce.description: The official ByteDance Seedance 2.5 announcement describes a model built around 30-second storytelling, richer reference inputs, and more precise video editing.

items.title: Longer single-pass stories
items.description: The model can generate up to 30 seconds in one pass and supports multiple rounds of extension for longer-form work.

items.title: Multimodal references
items.description: Use a broader mix of image, video, and audio references to guide characters, scenes, motion, composition, and sound.

items.title: Precise editing
items.description: Timestamp-aware direction, green-screen workflows, camera perspective changes, and reference-based edits support production tasks.

items.title: Professional blocking
items.description: White-model or clay-render references can communicate spatial structure, poses, camera paths, and scene blocking.

benefits.title: How to interpret Seedance 2.5 availability
benefits.description: Searches for Seedance 2.5, seedance2.5, and spelling variants often mix official announcements, consumer apps, providers, and third-party claims. Separate each access surface.

items.title: Official consumer rollout
items.description: ByteDance Seed says the model is rolling out on Jimeng AI, Doubao Pro, and other platforms. The exact experience still depends on account, region, and product.

items.title: BytePlus ModelArk API
items.description: BytePlus publishes model documentation and API access for supported markets. Use the current model ID and endpoint shown in official docs.

items.title: Third-party platforms
items.description: Higgsfield, CapCut, Artlist, fal, OpenRouter, and other names appear in searches, but support and limits must be checked on each provider’s current page.

items.title: This site’s generator
items.description: The browser generator on Seadance Video currently supports Seedance 2.0. It does not silently claim that Seedance 2.5 is selectable here.

features.title: Seedance 2.5 capability map
features.description: Use this map to connect a search query to the right page without treating an announcement as a promise of identical support everywhere.

items.title: 30-second generation
items.description: Official materials describe up to 30 seconds per generation, with multi-round extensions. Confirm the limit on the provider you use.

items.title: Reference images
items.description: The official API documentation describes expanded image references, with current limits and formats documented by the provider.

items.title: Reference video and audio
items.description: Video and audio references can guide motion, pacing, voice, and atmosphere, subject to input duration and file requirements.

items.title: Editing workflows
items.description: Green screen, camera perspective, timestamp-level changes, and reference-based editing are part of the announced capability set.

items.title: Multilingual direction
items.description: Model and provider language support can differ. Test the language and voice workflow you need instead of assuming every surface behaves identically.

items.title: Version-aware prompting
items.description: Keep the provider, model ID, settings, and date with each result because capabilities, pricing, and moderation rules can change.

faq.title: Seedance 2.5 FAQ
faq.description: Clear answers for the most common Seedance searches and workflows.

items.question: When was Seedance 2.5 released?
items.answer: ByteDance Seed published the official Seedance 2.5 introduction on July 31, 2026. Product and API availability can still vary by platform and region.

items.question: Is Seedance 2.5 available on this website?
items.answer: Not in this site’s browser generator. The current generator uses Seedance 2.0; this page explains how to evaluate official 2.5 access without presenting an unavailable model selector.

items.question: Where is the Seedance 2.5 official website?
items.answer: Official materials mention Jimeng AI, Doubao Pro, and BytePlus ModelArk in supported markets. Check the provider’s current login, region, plan, and model documentation before relying on a feature.

items.question: Does Seedance 2.5 have an API?
items.answer: BytePlus ModelArk now publishes a Seedance 2.5 API surface in supported markets. See the dedicated API page for access, model IDs, pricing checks, and request planning.

items.question: Is Seedance 2.5 free or unlimited?
items.answer: There is no universal free or unlimited entitlement. Consumer trials, subscriptions, API billing, and promotions vary by provider, region, and date.

items.question: Are “seadance 2.5” and “seeddance 2.5” different models?
items.answer: They are common search spelling variants. The official model name is Seedance 2.5; use the correctly spelled name when checking documentation or creating a request.

cta.title: Choose the right Seedance 2.5 access path
cta.description: Read the current provider documentation for 2.5, or use the supported Seedance 2.0 generator while planning your workflow.
